fit: reuse trained seed42 best checkpoint rankings; no retraining
candidates: full-catalog top500 recomputed from the same best checkpoint; first 100 verified identical to archived top100
score: float64 original score + beta * per-user top500 score range * match_indicator; zero range replaced by 1
selection: highest all-user valid NDCG per source/level, smallest beta on ties
profiles: train only; A2 n_items >= 2; any vehicle can match; universal and unknown get zero bonus
mismatch: known inferred mismatches / judged top10 pairs; unknown excluded; pair counts and coverage given
bootstrap: 2000 paired user resamples; fixed training seed; not uncertainty across model seeds
